title: floc-consistency pipeline parameters
description: Consistency of floc clustering across batch sizes, with SKA2 core SNP distances

assemblies.description: Directory of assemblies (.fa, .fasta, .fna, optionally .gz). Sample names are file names without extensions.

outdir.description: Output directory (use a bucket path, e.g. s3://..., on Seqera Platform).

batch_sizes.description: Comma-separated batch sizes, e.g. '10,50'. Overrides start/step/stop. The all-samples reference run is always added.

start.description: Smallest batch size (when batch_sizes is not set).

step.description: Increase between batch sizes (when batch_sizes is not set).

stop.description: Largest batch size before the reference run (default: number of samples).

shuffle.description: Shuffle the sample order (one order is used for every batch size).

floc_args.description: Extra floc options for every call, e.g. '-d 0.03 --min-hash-frac 0 --assign-metric avg'. Do not include -o or inputs.

core.description: group: core of samples linked by measured pairs; global: core of all measured samples; pairwise: split k-mers shared by each pair.

snp_threshold.description: Report discrepant pairs with fewer core SNPs than this.
